title: Add ¿Y si…? — Alternate History Scene Generator to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [¿Y si…? — Alternate History Scene Generator](https://jecxolab.github.io/y-si-historia) to image
- Type a historical "what if" and get the scene illustrated. Built for the Spanish-language history channel El Efecto Historia. Uses the Pollinations image API with four visual presets (epic oil paintin

Fixes #14311

gist.headline: History takes the scenic route
gist.blurb: ¿Y si…? plants a historical what-if in the image API and lets it grow into an illustrated alternate timeline. Built for El Efecto Historia, where one small counterfactual can apparently require an entire painting.
gist.summary: Added ¿Y si…?, a Spanish-language alternate-history scene generator for El Efecto Historia that turns historical “what if” prompts into Pollinations image generations with four visual presets.
gist.impact: Spanish-speaking history creators can now turn counterfactual scenarios into illustrated scenes directly through a purpose-built community app.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy alternate-history artist's studio where timelines branch like flowering vines from an open history book into four small framed illustrated scenes. Polli, wearing a tiny historian's cap and painter's smock, holds a brush beside the book while a retro terminal helps render the imagined past.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny historian’s cap and painter’s smock, painting an alternate-history timeline sprouting as flowering vines from an open book into four framed historical scenes; a retro computer nearby glows lime green (#ecf874). Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, code-plants and tiny flowers, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with simple pixel-font text: '¿Y SI…?'.
